NO_ROUTES_FOUND.title: No routes found
NO_ROUTES_FOUND.message: We couldn't find a bus route between these locations.
NO_ROUTES_FOUND.action: Try a different stop or adjust your search.

FARE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Fare unavailable
FARE_UNAVAILABLE.message: Fare data is not available for this journey.
FARE_UNAVAILABLE.action: Please confirm the fare with the conductor before boarding.

LIVE_DATA_UNAVAILABLE.title: Live data unavailable
LIVE_DATA_UNAVAILABLE.message: Real-time bus location is currently unavailable.

OPERATOR_OFFLINE.title: Operator system offline
OPERATOR_OFFLINE.message: The bus operator's system is temporarily unavailable.
OPERATOR_OFFLINE.action: We'll restore live data when the connection is restored.

PAYMENT_FAILED.title: Payment unsuccessful
PAYMENT_FAILED.message: Your payment could not be processed.
PAYMENT_FAILED.action: Please check your card details and try again, or use a different payment method.

BOOKING_EXPIRED.title: Booking expired
BOOKING_EXPIRED.action: Please restart your booking to select a new seat.

BUS_CANCELLED.title: Service cancelled
BUS_CANCELLED.message: This bus service has been cancelled.
BUS_CANCELLED.action: Please search for an alternative route.

GPS_PERMISSION_DENIED.title: Location access denied
GPS_PERMISSION_DENIED.message: BusLanka needs your location to find nearby stops.
GPS_PERMISSION_DENIED.action: Enable location access in your device settings, or search by stop name.

OFFLINE.title: No internet connection
OFFLINE.message: You're offline. Some features are unavailable.
OFFLINE.action: Saved routes and active tickets are available offline.

TICKET_INVALID.title: Invalid ticket
TICKET_INVALID.message: This ticket could not be verified.
TICKET_INVALID.action: Please contact the conductor or visit the help desk.

TICKET_EXPIRED.title: Ticket expired
TICKET_EXPIRED.message: This ticket is no longer valid.

SERVER_ERROR.title: Server error
SERVER_ERROR.action: Please try again in a moment. If the problem persists, contact support.

ORIGIN_NOT_FOUND.title: Origin not recognised
ORIGIN_NOT_FOUND.message: We couldn't find that starting location.
ORIGIN_NOT_FOUND.action: Try a different spelling or select from the map.

DESTINATION_NOT_FOUND.title: Destination not recognised
DESTINATION_NOT_FOUND.action: Try a different spelling or select from the map.
